_comment: Cambridge O Level Physics 5054 source papers for the Exam Lab image bank.
Add a new session by appending an entry; nothing else in the pipeline is
session-specific. `ms` may be null only for papers that are deliberately
excluded (see `include`). Durations and totals are read off the papers
themselves, not assumed from the 9702 equivalents.
EXCLUDED: 5054_sp23_qp_1 (specimen Paper 1) — Cambridge publishes no mark
scheme for the specimen multiple-choice paper, so no answer key exists and
the paper cannot be shipped without inventing answers.

papers.excluded_because: No mark scheme is published for the 5054 specimen Paper 1, so no verified answer key exists.
